title: SS27 Men's Celebrity Influence
summary: Front rows and designer-celebrities shaped SS27 menswear: Pharrell Williams's surf-themed Louis Vuitton and music stars at couture point to soft leather, satin and statement accessories.

sections.heading: What was seen
sections.body:
- Pharrell Williams built a sandy beach and an artificial wave for Louis Vuitton's surf-themed show<sup>[1]</sup>, and Louis Vuitton showed Speedy bags in many colours and beaded monogram versions<sup>[2]</sup>.
- At Paris couture week, Bad Bunny, Michelle Yeoh and Emma Corrin were among the stars at Schiaparelli<sup>[3]</sup>.
- Menswear's crossover with womenswear, noted by GQ France's Patrick Clark<sup>[1]</sup>, is visible in what male stars wear: satin, sheer shirts and jewellery.

sections.heading: Looks to build
sections.body:
- Soft leather blouson with a white tee and straight trousers.
- Satin shirt open over a rib tank.
- Beaded or coloured bag as the single statement.

design_implications: - Translate red-carpet ideas into wearable fabrics and one statement piece.
commercial_implications: - Time campaigns to festival and award seasons; avoid using celebrity names without agreements.
